title: Ghost Gate
summary: Privacy Lab demonstrates Ghost Gate access control on Esmeralda testnet. The Crypt v3 policy checks a qualifying revealed/public native-tTARI output against a 100 tTARI threshold and issues a time-limited session; it is not a confidential aggregate-balance proof. November 5 review read the updated creator submission, current MIT README and live Simple/Technical policy views. The creator reports November 4 compatibility updates for Sapient, embedded Web Tari Universe and Telegram admission. The operator and verifier remain trusted; Telegram grants are not persistent across restart. The linked GGBP1 v3 external-review package is synthetic threshold-proof research: it does not establish wallet ownership, chain inclusion, unspentness or admission authority. It is not integrated wallet support. The dated October 31 recording remains a walkthrough of the same public threshold policy and privacy limits; its browser-wallet capability error describes that capture environment. No wallet, proof, group admission or research code was executed during this review.
cardSummary: Check a testnet token threshold for access while keeping total wallet holdings outside the application’s request.
